data.name: Daffa
data.gender_notes: Daffa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Daffah’, which means ‘noble’ or ‘distinguished’. In Islamic history, Daffah was a title given to the honor guard who stood by the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) during his final illness. The name Daffa carries the meaning “Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Daffa usually hope their child will grow to embody noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carries the spiritual symbolism of nobility, honor, and distinction.
data.etymology: Daffa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daffa total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: ضفة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم الضفة مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ض ف ف' والذي يعني الاقتراب أو القرب. الضفة تعني الجانب أو الحافة، وغالبًا ما تستخدم للإشارة إلى ضفة النهر أو الجبل. في سياق الأسماء الإسلامية، قد تشير الضفة إلى مكان أو موقع ذو أهمية دينية أو روحية.

in_urdu.name: ضفة
in_urdu.meaning: ضفة کا مطلب ہے کنارہ یا جھیل
in_urdu.long_meaning: ضفة کا نام عربی جذر 'ض ف ف' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے قریب یا قرب. اس نام کا تعلق ضفة النيل یا ضفة الجبل سے ہو سکتا ہے، جو اسلامی تقالید میں روحانی اہمیت کے حامل مقامات کے طور پر شمار ہوتے ہیں.

in_hindi.name: दफ़ा
in_hindi.meaning: दफ़ा का अर्थ है तट या किनारा
in_hindi.long_meaning: दफ़ा नाम की उत्पत्ति العربية जड़ 'ض ف ف' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है निकट या समीप। यह नाम नदी के किनारे या पहाड़ी किनारे को संदर्भित कर सकता है, जो इस्लामी परंपरा में आध्यात्मिक महत्व के स्थानों के रूप में माने जाते हैं।

in_pashto.name: دافه
in_pashto.meaning: دافه د سيند یا غره د څنګل په معنا ده
in_pashto.long_meaning: د دافه نوم د عربي ريښې 'ض ف ف' څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د نږدې يا نژدې معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د سيند د څنګل يا غره د څنګل په معنا کارول کیدی شي، کوم چې په اسلامي دود کې د روحاني اهميت لرونکو ځايونو په توګه ګڼل کیږي.

in_english.name: Daffa
in_english.meaning: Daffa means side, edge, or bank

In Islamic tradition, the name may symbolize a place of spiritual significance or a location with cultural importance. The name Daffa is often associated with qualities such as proximity, closeness, or being on the right path.

historical_references.reference: The Daffa-i Kadimah, also known as the Old Mosque, is a historical mosque located in the Old City of Dhaka, Bangladesh. It is one of the oldest mosques in the country and is believed to have been built during the reign of Sultan Alauddin Masud Shah (1352-1369 AD). The mosque is named 'Daffa' due to its location near a large earthen mound or 'daffa' where the bodies of Muslim soldiers were buried after the Battle of Lakhnauti in 1570 AD.
